description: This file defines a RuntimeCache class for managing cached runtime states within a control plane. It includes types for runtime state, cache entries, and snapshots.

classes.name: RuntimeCache
classes.description: A class that manages a cache of runtime states associated with actor keys, providing methods to set, get, clear, and snapshot cache entries, as well as collecting idle candidates based on inactivity.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of cache entries.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a cache entry exists for the given actor key.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the runtime state for a given actor key, optionally touching (refreshing) its lastTouchedAt timestamp.

methods.name: peek
methods.description: Retrieves the runtime state for a given actor key without updating its lastTouchedAt timestamp.

methods.name: getLastTouchedAt
methods.description: Returns the lastTouchedAt timestamp for a given actor key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a runtime state associated with an actor key and updates its lastTouchedAt timestamp.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes a cache entry for a specified actor key.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns an array of cached runtime snapshots, including idle time calculations.

methods.name: collectIdleCandidates
methods.description: Returns cache entries that have been idle longer than maxIdleMs.

ctags.name: cache
ctags.pattern: /^  private readonly cache = new Map<string, RuntimeCacheEntry>();$/

fields.name: private readonly cache = new Map<string, RuntimeCacheEntry>();
